insights.label: Pressure Exposure by Innings
insights.text: Second-innings chases exhibit significantly higher leverage and pressure concentration: 36.9% of chase deliveries reach PI >= P80 compared to 4.7% in the first innings.

insights.label: Strict Pressure Sample Thresholds
insights.text: Out of 881 batters and 640 bowlers in the historical database, exactly 306 players (155 batters, 151 bowlers) meet the pre-registered minimum exposure threshold of >= 60 pressure deliveries across >= 8 distinct matches.

insights.label: Proven Tier Selectivity
insights.text: Only 7 batters and 2 bowlers satisfied the dual requirement for Proven tier status: posterior P(outperform) >= 95.0% and effective pressure sample size n_eff >= 136.23 (the empirical population median).

insights.label: Top Proven Clutch Batter
insights.text: Pathum Nissanka recorded the highest Clutch Delta among Proven batters, elevating his scoring rate by +27.0 runs per 100 balls under high pressure relative to normal match conditions.

insights.label: Top Proven Clutch Bowler
insights.text: Sunil Narine recorded the largest clutch saving among Proven bowlers, conceding 0.52 fewer runs per over under pressure compared to his normal match baseline.

insights.label: Ranking Stability Across Sensitivity Grid
insights.text: Across 500 joint perturbations of pressure definitions, value metrics, weights, and outlier sigmas, the primary Top 10 retains an average overlap of 8.8/10 for batters and 8.4/10 for bowlers.

insights.label: IPL to T20I Transferability Divergence
insights.text: Batting clutch skill displays statistically significant positive transfer between IPL and T20I (Spearman rho = +0.345), whereas bowling clutch value displays near-zero correlation (rho = -0.048), highlighting the outsized influence of ground dimensions and pitch conditions on bowling.

insights.label: Concealed Clutch Value (Hidden Gems)
insights.text: The platform uncovered 11 Hidden Gems (10 batters, 1 bowlers) who achieve P(outperform) >= 80% despite falling below median raw volume or conventional strike-rate / economy ranks.

insights.label: Reconstruction Precision Across Competitions
insights.text: Bayesian target reconstruction achieves a pooled standard error of 2.0687 runs (IPL sigma = 1.874, T20I sigma = 2.177), well within the pre-registered <= 6.0 SD tolerance.

insights.label: Chase End Feasibility Rate
insights.text: 96.8% of eligible non-DLS chases cleanly achieve their official result on or before the final legal delivery, exceeding the strict pre-registered gate of >= 95.0%.
